question: 'Poush Mela' is a unique festival celebrated in which of the following Indian states?
solution: The correct answer is __**West Bengal**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • Poush Mela is a festival celebrated in the Indian state of West Bengal: • Poush Mela is held in Santiniketan, in the Birbhum district of West Bengal • Poush Mela is held on the 7th day of the Poush month and lasts for three days. • However, since 2017, it has been extended to six days due to its popularity. • Poush Mela is a festival that marks the beginning of the harvest season. • It features live performances of Bengali folk music, such as baul, kirtan, and Kobigan. • It also displays local artisans, food, and culture.
